units.note: Numbers check: ten triremes (δέκα τριήρων), three months (τριμήνου), 10,000 talents over 50 years at 200 Euboic talents a year, 100 hostages aged 14-30 all correct. Out of scope, recorded only: 'before making war on Rome' leaves out τὸν τελευταῖον ('the last war'). αὐτοῖς in ἐντὸς τῶν ἀποδειχθησομένων ὅρων αὐτοῖς is ambiguous (Masinissa or the Carthaginians); English 'him' is a defensible reading.

findings.quote: had returned to it only after more than forty-five years
findings.problem: πλείω δὲ τῶν πέντε καὶ τετταράκοντ᾽ ἐτῶν ἔχων εἰς αὐτὴν ἐπανήκει: ἔχων + years gives his age. He came back when he was over forty-five years old, not after forty-five years away. He left at nine (ἐνναέτης), so he was gone for about thirty-six years.
findings.proposed_fix: was now returning to it at more than forty-five years of age
